title: How do I Spend my Day?: Time of Day and Days of the Week
seo_title: Time of Day and Days of the Week Class 1 Worksheet with Answers (Joyful Mathematics Chapter 10)
standard_code: Class 1, Joyful Mathematics Chapter 10: How do I Spend my Day?
standard_text: Time: sequencing events of the day, morning, afternoon, evening and night, longer and shorter durations, days of the week (summary of NCERT Joyful Mathematics Class 1)
meta_desc: Class 1 How do I Spend my Day? worksheet (Joyful Mathematics Chapter 10): times of day, order of events, days of the week and o'clock times. 100 picture questions with answers.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • We wake up in the morning, have lunch in the afternoon, play in the evening and sleep at night.
  • The days of the week: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday.

Examples

Example

What comes after Wednesday?

Say the days in order

Answer: Thursday

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Mixing up yesterday and tomorrowYesterday was before today; tomorrow comes after.
Reading the short hand as minutesOn a clock the short hand shows the hour.

faq.q: How many days are in a week?
What should Class 1 children know about clocks?
faq.a: Reading o'clock times and knowing the order of daily events.

items.q: What time of day is it?
items.e: The sun is low and coming up (the arrow points up). It is morning.

items.q: What time of day is it?
items.e: The sun is high in the middle of the sky. It is lunchtime (the middle of the day).

items.q: What time of day is it?
items.e: The sun is going down (the arrow points down). It is afternoon.

items.q: What time of day is it?
items.e: It is dark, with the moon and stars. It is night time.

items.q: Look at the sky. Is it morning, lunchtime, afternoon or night time?
items.e: The sun is low and coming up (the arrow points up). It is morning.

items.q: Look at the sky. Is it morning, lunchtime, afternoon or night time?
items.e: The sun is high in the middle of the sky. It is lunchtime (the middle of the day).

items.q: Look at the sky. Is it morning, lunchtime, afternoon or night time?
items.e: The sun is going down (the arrow points down). It is afternoon.

items.q: Look at the sky. Is it morning, lunchtime, afternoon or night time?
items.e: It is dark, with the moon and stars. It is night time.

items.q: Aarav looks out of the window. What time of day is it?
items.e: The sun is low and coming up (the arrow points up). It is morning.

items.q: Rehan looks out of the window. What time of day is it?
items.e: The sun is high in the middle of the sky. It is lunchtime (the middle of the day).

items.q: When does Nikhil usually eat breakfast?
items.e: Most children eat breakfast in the morning.

items.q: When does Gauri usually eat lunch at school?
items.e: Most children eat lunch at school at lunchtime.

items.q: When does Aarav usually go to sleep in bed?
items.e: Most children go to sleep in bed at night time.

items.q: When does Shreya usually wake up and get dressed?
items.e: Most children wake up and get dressed in the morning.

items.q: When does Dev usually go home from school?
items.e: Most children go home from school in the afternoon.

items.q: When does Tara usually see the stars?
items.e: Most children see the stars at night time.

items.q: When does Varun usually walk to school?
items.e: Most children walk to school in the morning.

items.q: When does Ishaan usually eat a sandwich in the middle of the school day?
items.e: Most children eat a sandwich in the middle of the school day at lunchtime.

items.q: When does Rehan usually have dinner and a bath?
items.e: Most children have dinner and a bath at night time.

items.q: When does Meera usually play at the park after school?
items.e: Most children play at the park after school in the afternoon.

items.q: Which happens first in a school day: go to bed, eat lunch, eat dinner?
c: They all happen at the same time
items.e: The day goes in order: eat lunch, eat dinner, go to bed. Eat lunch comes first.

items.q: Which happens first in a school day: go home, go to bed, eat dinner?
c: They all happen at the same time
items.e: The day goes in order: go home, eat dinner, go to bed. Go home comes first.

items.q: Put these in order for a school day: go to school, eat dinner, wake up.
c: Wake up, go to school, eat dinner
Go to school, eat dinner, wake up
Go to school, wake up, eat dinner
Eat dinner, go to school, wake up
items.e: Start with the earliest thing: Wake up, go to school, eat dinner.

items.q: Which happens last in a school day: wake up, eat lunch, eat breakfast?
c: They all happen at the same time
items.e: The day goes in order: wake up, eat breakfast, eat lunch. Eat lunch comes last.

items.q: Which happens last in a school day: go home, eat lunch, go to bed?
c: They all happen at the same time
items.e: The day goes in order: eat lunch, go home, go to bed. Go to bed comes last.

items.q: Put these in order for a school day: eat lunch, go home, wake up.
c: Eat lunch, wake up, go home
Eat lunch, go home, wake up
Go home, eat lunch, wake up
Wake up, eat lunch, go home
items.e: Start with the earliest thing: Wake up, eat lunch, go home.

items.q: Put these in order for a school day: eat breakfast, eat lunch, go to school.
c: Eat breakfast, eat lunch, go to school
Eat lunch, go to school, eat breakfast
Go to school, eat breakfast, eat lunch
Eat breakfast, go to school, eat lunch
items.e: Start with the earliest thing: Eat breakfast, go to school, eat lunch.

items.q: Which happens last in a school day: eat breakfast, go home, wake up?
c: They all happen at the same time
items.e: The day goes in order: wake up, eat breakfast, go home. Go home comes last.

items.q: Put these in order for a school day: wake up, eat lunch, go to school.
c: Go to school, wake up, eat lunch
Wake up, eat lunch, go to school
Eat lunch, go to school, wake up
Wake up, go to school, eat lunch
items.e: Start with the earliest thing: Wake up, go to school, eat lunch.

items.q: Put these in order for a school day: wake up, eat lunch, eat breakfast.
c: Wake up, eat lunch, eat breakfast
Eat breakfast, wake up, eat lunch
Wake up, eat breakfast, eat lunch
Eat lunch, eat breakfast, wake up
items.e: Start with the earliest thing: Wake up, eat breakfast, eat lunch.

items.q: Varun eats breakfast. When is that?
items.e: Breakfast is the first meal of the day. We eat it in the morning.

items.q: The sun comes up. What part of the day is it?
items.e: The sun comes up at the start of the day. That is the morning.

items.q: Which happens in the morning?
items.e: We get up in the morning. Tea and bedtime are in the evening. Home time is in the afternoon.

items.q: School finishes for the day. What part of the day is it?
items.e: School finishes after lunch, before tea. That is the afternoon.

items.q: Yash goes to bed. When is that?
items.e: Children go to bed at the end of the day, in the evening.

items.q: Which happens in the evening?
items.e: Tea is the meal at the end of the day. We have it in the evening.

items.q: Which part of the school day comes first?
items.e: The day goes in this order: morning, lunchtime, afternoon, evening.

items.q: Which part of the day comes straight after the afternoon?
items.e: Morning, afternoon, then evening. The evening comes straight after the afternoon.

items.q: Put these in order: evening, morning, afternoon. Which is in the middle?
items.e: The order is morning, afternoon, evening. The afternoon is in the middle.

items.q: What happens first?
items.e: Follow the arrows from the left. The first box is wake up.

items.q: Which day comes after Monday?
items.e: The days go Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday, then Monday again. After Monday comes Tuesday.

items.q: Which day comes before Wednesday?
items.e: Count back one day from Wednesday: Tuesday.

items.q: Which day comes after Tuesday?
items.e: The days go Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday, then Monday again. After Tuesday comes Wednesday.

items.q: Which day is missing?
items.e: The days go in order: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday. The missing day is Wednesday.

items.q: How many days are in one week?
items.e: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday: 7 days.

items.q: Which day comes after Wednesday?
items.e: The days go Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday, then Monday again. After Wednesday comes Thursday.

items.q: Which day comes before Friday?
items.e: Count back one day from Friday: Thursday.

items.q: Which day comes after Thursday?
items.e: The days go Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday, then Monday again. After Thursday comes Friday.

items.q: Which day is missing?
items.e: The days go in order: Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday. The missing day is Friday.

items.q: Which two days are the weekend?
items.e: Most children do not go to school on the weekend: Saturday and Sunday.

items.q: Today is Monday. What day will it be tomorrow?
items.e: Tomorrow is the next day. After Monday comes Tuesday.

items.q: Today is Thursday. What day was it yesterday?
items.e: Yesterday is the day before. Before Thursday comes Wednesday.

items.q: Today is Sunday. Aria has sport on Monday. When is that?
items.e: Monday comes straight after Sunday, so it is tomorrow.

items.q: Today is Wednesday. Gauri had music on Tuesday. When was that?
items.e: Tuesday is the day before Wednesday, so it was yesterday.

items.q: Today is Saturday. What day will it be tomorrow?
items.e: Tomorrow is the next day. After Saturday comes Sunday.

items.q: Today is Tuesday. What day was it yesterday?
items.e: Yesterday is the day before. Before Tuesday comes Monday.

items.q: Today is Friday. Neha has a football game on Saturday. When is that?
items.e: Saturday comes straight after Friday, so it is tomorrow.

items.q: Today is Monday. Varun had a birthday party on Sunday. When was that?
items.e: Sunday is the day before Monday, so it was yesterday.

items.q: Today is Thursday. What day will it be tomorrow?
items.e: Tomorrow is the next day. After Thursday comes Friday.

items.q: Today is Sunday. What day was it yesterday?
items.e: Yesterday is the day before. Before Sunday comes Saturday.

items.q: It is 3 o’clock. What time will it be in 1 hour?
items.e: In 1 hour the short hand moves on to the next number. 3 o’clock → 4 o’clock. (2 o’clock was 1 hour ago.)

items.q: It is 9 o’clock. What time will it be in half an hour?
items.e: In half an hour the long hand goes from the 12 down to the 6. 9 o’clock → half past 9. (10 o’clock is 1 hour later.)

items.q: It is half past 4. What time will it be in half an hour?
items.e: In half an hour the long hand goes from the 6 back up to the 12. A new hour starts: 5 o’clock. (Half past 5 is 1 hour later.)

items.q: It is half past 2. What time will it be in 1 hour?
items.e: In 1 hour the hour goes up by 1 and it is still half past. Half past 2 → half past 3.

items.q: Karan eats breakfast. When could it be?
items.e: We eat breakfast in the morning, before school: 7:00 in the morning.

items.q: School starts. When could it be?
items.e: School starts in the morning: 8:30 in the morning. At night we are asleep.

items.q: Rehan eats dinner with his family. When could it be?
items.e: Dinner is in the evening: 6:00 in the evening. 6:00 in the morning is time for breakfast.

items.q: Nisha goes to bed. When could it be?
items.e: We go to bed at night: 8:00 at night. 8:00 in the morning is time for school.
